title: Response to a Product Complaint
paragraphs: We apologize for the trouble you experienced in your recent order. Our staff read your complaint carefully and understand why you feel dissatisfied. The item you received had a broken screen, and we agree this is not acceptable.

As a solution, we will send a free replacement within five business days. If the new item still has the same issue, we will replace it again or return your full payment. We will also add a 10 dollar credit to your account as a small gesture of goodwill.
Thank you for your patience. Please reply to this email if you have any questions.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of this email?
options: To apologize for a defective item and offer a replacement
To announce a new customer support policy
To request payment for a broken screen
To introduce a new staff member
The item had a broken screen

questions.stem: What will the company do in addition to sending a replacement?
options: Ask David to pay for return shipping
Add a 10 dollar credit to his account
Send a new staff member to visit

questions.stem: What will most likely happen if the replacement has the same issue?
options: David will be charged for the item
The order will be canceled without explanation
Anna will personally deliver a new item
The company will replace it again or return the full payment
